name: netsujo-aio
description: Production-ready AIO/SEO toolkit for Next.js + Strapi + Japanese sites. 20 skills covering GSC weekly audit, full JSON-LD suite (FAQPage/Organization/Article/Event/Breadcrumb/Speakable), llms.txt for AI search, GA4 custom dimensions + tracking wiring, Japanese-specific quality gates (H1 mobile break, ASCII↔CJK space), AI citation tracking (ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overview), Bing IndexNow submission, passage citability scoring (CMU GEO framework), indexation recovery for Discovered/Crawled-not-indexed pages, and pre-merge test suite (link-integrity / content-fact-validator / schema-validator) for catching semantic mismatches, fabricated content, and broken JSON-LD before deploy.
